{{Top|leg}}
A '''percussion rifle''' was a single-shot, muzzle loading weapon that fired explosive projectiles, and could be fitted with a bayonet attachment. [[Exocron Airfleet]] guards carried them as their standard weapon while on duty. They were considered to be archaic by [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].
